prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic full-body editorial photograph of one unmistakably adult woman cyclist at a fogbound ferry bicycle checkpoint. Treat the supplied portrait solely as facial, hair, and general-appearance inspiration for an original fictional adult, carrying over long dark wavy hair, natural facial detail, and a calm neutral expression. On the wet salt-sprayed vehicle deck, she steadies a road bicycle with her left hand and presents a paper ferry ticket toward a small illuminated scanner with her right. She wears clearly identifiable cycling bib shorts: fitted cycling shorts form two coherent thigh-length leg openings; the cycling shorts continue upward into one upper bib torso section; two garment-owned bib straps continue over the shoulders; an anatomically placed saddle-pad region or explicit bicycle-riding context remains visible; the garment must remain a purpose-built bib-short system. Dark technical fabric runs continuously from the chamois-shaped crotch through the shorts and upper mesh bib, with the two sewn-in straps and both separate short hems plainly readable. Frame her head-to-shoes in a stable three-quarter stance. Keep the bicycle slightly behind her to camera-right, ferry railings beyond her silhouette, and amber deck lights high and lateral, leaving the straps, upper torso, waist, crotch, both thighs, and hems unobscured. Visual priority: shoulders/upper torso, waist, crotch, both thighs/short hems, and cycling context must remain inspectable in the same frame. Amber deck lamps shine through maritime fog, casting salt-beaded reflections across wet steel while the lowered checkpoint barrier, wheel channel, deck arrows, and distant wake establish the ferry passage. Preserve realistic anatomy, natural fabric tension, restrained color, documentary depth, and crisp garment-edge separation.
